summary: Coverage mode: added tests for the untested http client, the todo hooks, TodoEmptyState and AppProviders-adjacent logic, and extended the util, API and notice tests. The frontend typecheck is clean and the full suite passes with 60 tests.

decisions.reason: Composition only; covered by the existing App.test.tsx test 'composes the application header and tasks page'. I did not read App.tsx itself, only that test's name.
Provider wiring with no logic; the default client prop is exercised by App.test.tsx.
Static markup; the existing ApplicationHeader.test.tsx covers the home link, title and description. I did not read the source file.
Presentational component already covered by the 2 tests in SuccessNotice.test.tsx. I did not read the source file.
The existing test covers the query-error and retry path. The toggle success and failure notices, the editor and delete dialog wiring, and the busy-disabled state have no test (follow-up).
update and remove had no tests.
scenarios: patches only the provided fields on update
sends a DELETE request when removing a task

The component branches on hasTodos and disabled and had no test.

The existing test covers the enabled and disabled create button. I did not read the source file.

decisions.reason: The HTTP client had no tests for its success, error and abort branches.
scenarios: returns parsed JSON and prefixes the path with /api
merges custom headers over the defaults
returns undefined for a 204 response
shows a validation message for a 422 response
uses a string detail from the error body
falls back to a generic message for a non-string detail
falls back to a generic message for a non-JSON error body
reports a connection problem when fetch fails
rethrows the original error when the request was aborted

notes: I did not read every target before deciding. App.tsx, ApplicationHeader.tsx, SuccessNotice.tsx, DeleteTodoDialog.tsx, TodoFilters.tsx, TodoForm.tsx and TodosHeader.tsx were skipped based only on their existing test names, so those skips are unverified.
Component tests for TodosPage, TodoEditor, TodoItem, TodoList and DeleteTodoDialog each have a single test, and several branches remain uncovered. I did not extend them.
The typecheck produced no output, so I treated it as clean. It reports 0 passed and 0 failed because there are no test counts to give.
src/lib/http.ts: a 422 response always returns the fixed validation message and ignores the server's detail text, which may be intentional.
